hybrid_rule: existing count-based polarity is preserved unless existing confidence < 0.10; then QRS-first selector is used
external_model_influences: NeuroKit's documented default detector identifies QRS complexes using steepness of the absolute ECG gradient and then finds the R peak within the QRS region.
NeuroKit also exposes multiple established QRS detectors, including Pan-Tompkins, Hamilton, Christov, Elgendi, and others, reinforcing QRS-specific preprocessing rather than raw prominence alone.
SleepECG is an open Python ECG heartbeat-detection project used as a second implementation reference.
note: No selector was promoted based on this MIT-BIH result. The primary locked benchmark remains unchanged. This experiment uses an independent local WFDB-format decoder for the uploaded archive; formal promotion requires rerunning with official wfdb-python.
